headline: RattanIndia Power faces Rs 170.78 crore liability from BHEL arbitral award
hook: Arbitral award hits RattanIndia Power hard
summary: RattanIndia Power has been hit with an arbitral award liability amounting to Rs 170.78 crore in favor of Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL). This substantial financial obligation creates an immediate cash flow pressure for the power generation company. Retail investors holding shares in RattanIndia Power need to assess how this unexpected liability impacts the company's debt servicing and overall financial health.
whats_next: Company response or legal challenge regarding the arbitral award
why_it_matters: Unexpected cash outflow strains RattanIndia Power finances.
